notes.title: Version 0.16.0 released - How do I look?
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers!

It is time for yet another update to King of Retail. 

During this past year I have been blessed with having the assistance of my graphics artist who has added and upgraded a lot of things in the game, which have given a great lift to the overall visuals, as well as allowing me to focus more on programming and implementing new features. 
But as the game gets bigger and bigger, much time goes into managing things that doesn't directly impact the game features themselves. Playtesting, balancing, bug hunting, translation management and so on. 

And now I am very pleased to say that another person has joined the team, making it a grand total of 3 people working directly on King of Retail. 
She will be assisting me in doing many of these tasks, as well as adding new stuff to the game as she also is quite capable with Photoshop. 
So I am looking much forward to this, and I hope we will be able to make King of Retail even more enjoyable for you to play.

But on to the actual changes. 
For a long time we have been preparing and designing new characters to bring a much more diverse looking population to the game, instead of having all residents in the city looking all the same.
Let us have a look of what have been added.[/b]



[h2]--- New faces ---[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/74798daffb5290a507c44eca54ccacf532c04476.png[/img]

Instead of having 2 faces to choose from, we changed it into a slider system, where you can adjust the facial traits with more detail. You can also freely select hair color, as well as select between more, better looking hair styles.



[h2]--- New Outfits ---[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/64872ead5442e212f6c6c4f709fc2a301c1426f7.png[/img]

Before this update, all customers in your store wore the same clothes. But that is over now, as they have received unique clothings that better fit their individual segment.



[h2]--- Staff Uniforms ---[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/07f7ceab821200e42aeff4ff0b3e80ea8848ccfb.png[/img]

It is also now possible to design your own uniforms for your various stores and concepts. Should your staff have a simple, or an exclusive look. Tailor the outfit to match the look of the rest of your store.



[h2]--- Bugs & Small conveniences ---[/h2]

[h2]- Minimum storage system[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f9966905dc42da5cc08acde081632089627f7cf0.png[/img]

Many of you have also requested an easier use of the minimum storage system, so now it's possible to add directly to this when ordering an article, making it much easier to setup when starting a new store.

[h2]- Keybindings[/h2]

Keybinds did not save between closing and opening the game, this should be fixed so you don't have to remap the keys every time.

[h2]- Color picker[/h2]

It was time to look at an old and popular request which is a bit over due. But now the color picker has been updated such that you have complete control in selecting the exact color that you want. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f9bd1315c4577c2144972768ecc7021ef5cc5df3.png[/img]


[h2]--- Up next ---[/h2]

[h3]- New environments[/h3]
My graphics artist has been done for a while with these new characters as the last work is always implementing the actual things to the game. So she is already making good progress with the next big graphical update, which is new environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/90f171a64b18ef02ffcf95260bfe83e32fc3342a.png[/img]

So soon you will finally have variety in the areas where you manage your stores, and they will better exemplify the area you are in, in the campaign mode. Plus, they look much nicer than the existing area that i could conjure up back in the day.

[h3]- Thieves[/h3]
With the new characters and skills, it's about putting it a bit to use. A very popular request during all of the development period has been thieves in the stores. So i thought i would finally accomodate this request, and allow you to take on the battle with these persons that doesn't want to pay for your hard earned in game articles.

[h3]- New careers[/h3]
When campaign mode was introduced, clothes was the only existing type of article in the game, which is why there only exist these career paths where you sell clothes. So to add to the diversity a bit, we will be working on adding more of these, so this starting phase can vary a bit from time to time.



[b]That was it for this update.
As always, I am very interested in listening to new ideas, bug reports and what else you might have to tell.

You are also more than welcome to join our Discord!

[url=https://www.Discord.gg/fckN6bE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/2d23cbd46a7bf387d488e366c7d3f547ff26728d.png[/img][/url]

Until next time, have a great sale
//Daniel[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.13.1 released - How does it work again?
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers!

It is time for yet another update to King of Retail. The primary focus has been on easing the onboarding for new players, and to better explain many of the game's mechanics to those that want to go deep into the micromanagement aspect of the game. So lets get to it.[/b]

[h2]--- Tutorials ---[/h2]
Many of you have reported difficulties when starting the game and learning some of the terms and mechanics that exist in the game. Also the existing ones were in much need of an upgrade, as they were outdated.
So much has been changed, and replaced with a new system that makes it easier for me to maintain and add new stuff when the need for it arises. 

[h3]- Business School[/h3]
At the main menu as well as at the university in campaign mode you can access the business school. Here you find the more explanatory tutorials presented as small courses you can take on various subjects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/c2cfba4bc8d884a458e6def85222da87dc521819.png[/img]

[h3]- Campaign[/h3]
Getting into the campaign mode has been a bit confusing for many to find their way around it all, given that the only vague explanations are at the City Hall. These are still there, but now you also have a more bullet point type of tutorial that will assist you along the road, which hopefully will make this experience a lot easier and more understandable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d2767ef3948aa03b5b23f3406524e484678bae44.png[/img]

[h3]- In store[/h3]
The in store tutorial looks almost the same, but it has more tasks now that will bring you more around the store, giving you a better chance to understand what is possible at the store. 

[h3]- Office[/h3]
The office tutorial was the last remaining part with looks from the old UI. This has been changed to look like the rest of the game. 

[h2]--- New Articles ---[/h2]
Focus in this patch has not been so much on adding content, but we have still managed to add a new pack of shoes to the game. 
This was a bit underrepresented compared to the rest of the categories in clothing, which is why we decided to complete this category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/35a6fe36f1a2b3c3f0da3eecd0c12e666d826077.png[/img]

[h2]--- Logos ---[/h2]
To the ones that haven't experimented with their own logos, there is now a much bigger selection to choose from when designing your stores, compared to the previous four to select from. Hopefully it will bring some variation to your stores and corporations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3b6e7b734cecc65bed5d7cfc514d8108bde62076.png[/img]

[h2]--- Quality of Life ---[/h2]
As you can see there has not been work on one massive feature alone, but development has been diversified a bit. A part of this was adding many minor changes to existing features and screens,

[h3]- Article overlay[/h3]
This has been updated so you have much more information available when looking at the article. As many has requested it also shows if the article is present at the store, making it easier to find any articles that are only taking up space in storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/7154d87826fb94cd3413f46d325ba0a7321df47a.png[/img]

[h3]- Set task for all days[/h3]
You can now set an employee to do one task all week with one button, instead of having to do it individually for each day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/bd75925ec19c668fc525429c01b55f3628284bea.png[/img]

[h3]- Options at office[/h3]
When you press "Escape" at the office, you now have access to the regular menu. Here you can also revisit the office tutorial if that is your desire.

[h3]- Minor UI changes[/h3]
Other than the above many screens have in general received small tweaks here and there. Nothing big and noticeable, but small details that should improve the overall usage. 
During the next period work on improving existing screens will still continue.

[h3]- Bugs[/h3]
Also some minor bugs have been fixed, and I am very appreciative of bugs you find and report. Even though they are not fixed immediately they all go to my list of things I need to look at, so please continue to report stuff you might find in game.

[h2]--- New Art---[/h2]
With all of these in-game changes, I couldn't leave the game's art behind. We've worked hard with an artist to create this brand new cover art for King of Retail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/6da99490e97c846004ed1eaf565011d4c4d1e8c7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/9ede1ebf561ba219fab17136430acf739bbe78ee.jpg[/img]

[h2]--- Whats next? ---[/h2]
Those were the major changes for this version. And we are already preparing for the next one. It is not fully planned how much it will contain, but I can at least tell some of the things we intend to do.

[h3]- Women's clothing[/h3]
The reason we haven't got that many new articles in this update is because we also have been working on a new category. My super fantastic graphics artist has been spending many hours on making various women's shoes and clothes. 
There is still work to do on this, as the plan is that it can be playable with a large selection of articles from the next update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e871c4421b81ffd0563f6d596412d70b44f07a63.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/08f5ecce12a6fc00e8dfcdff837fbbb8b5260957.png[/img]

[h3]- Options[/h3]
It might also be the time to expand the in-game options apart from graphics and sound settings. So this will also be added in the next update, and ideas for stuff to add to a "General Options" screen is more then welcome.




[b]That was it for this update. As always, feedback, bug reports and ideas are always very welcome. Both here and on the Discord, which you can join here:


[url=https://www.Discord.gg/fckN6bE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/2d23cbd46a7bf387d488e366c7d3f547ff26728d.png[/img][/url]


I am off to work on the next update.

Until next time, happy sales.

Cheers
Daniel[/b]

notes.title: Update v.0.10.3: Give me my tablet!
notes.notes:
Dear Retailers,

[u]The latest version is now live! [/u]

Initially, this update only included new tablets. However, along the way a bit more stuff has been added. This combined with the new partnership with Iceberg Interactive, the brand new publishers of the game, has resulted in a longer development period than originally intended. 

Let’s have a look at the new content:

[h2]--- Tablets ---[/h2]

As mentioned, tablets have been added to the game. More precisely, 60 of them.
Tablets are part of the Mobile Devices category, which falls under the electronics departments. The new addition of tablets means that it should now be possible to run a specialized electronic store focusing mainly on Mobile Devices or Computers. The electronics department was lacking in content, so I am aiming to correct this with today's and future updates. That’s right, more articles will be added in the future.

As a category, Tablets are priced in between Computers and Phones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/357f745feeb44d54e036f47c54e2bed3c801928d.png[/img]

[h2]--- Logo designer ---[/h2]

The system of importing your own logos to the game has always been a bit confusing and buggy if you used more than one. So instead of trying to fix this, it was much easier to make a completely new system! You can now import logos directly from the main menu, and let the system handle the files and the weird names they should be given. This system should make it a whole lot easier to customize your stores to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/ddf1540c14ee237d94a24024152348a2ecb8357f.png[/img]

If it works as it should without unexpected issues, I plan to use the same system to customize posters and signs inside your stores in the future. So please do let me know your feedback! 


[h2]--- New calendar ---[/h2]

After adding all the days, weeks and months to the game, I found out that the calendar didn’t support this system, and had a lot of bugs. So like the logo designer, it was easier to create a new system. The calendar now focuses on the week ahead, instead of an entire month, which is quite some time in-game and probably included too much information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/8bb02192199fc2b80c9604fe3d4dee5d6bb0c5aa.png[/img]

[h2]--- Applications ---[/h2]

The applications were also an old remnant from a system created two years ago. So instead of pinned photos lying on your desk, it now has proper applications. From these applications, you might also learn something about the person before conducting the interview, allowing you to save time when looking for the right employee for your store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d6fb58952b273ce861295498fdc94eb26805ed3d.png[/img]

[h2]--- Other bugs ---[/h2]

I have also spent some time solving a whole lot of bugs. Of these, the most significant fixes are:
-	When you fired an employee, you were unable to move away from the board.
-	Renegotiating a wage made you unable to use the advertising table.
-	The lot info board in corporation mode now shows the correct amount of employees.
-	Fixed collision on some articles and freezers.
-	Some colors did not update correctly when designing your displays.
-	Staff wouldn't go to a specific register when placed too close to a wall.
-	Cancelling while adding/removing articles from the display actually cancels the display.
-	Tooltips added to various buttons.
-	Beverages can now be sorted by supplier when selecting those.
-	Updated translations from community translator and fixed a few typo’s

[h2]--- Translations ---[/h2]

The translations are also, as always, making progress with each update. I can’t thank you enough for helping me translate the game into your language. 

This is the current progress so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/c6e3a7541520a374c6ec010bc7ef1354fa2dce55.png[/img]


[b]This is it for the current update! I hope you will enjoy the changes. If you encounter any bugs please don’t hesitate to let me know so that they can be fixed.[/b]

Feel free to join our Discord at: [url=https://discord.gg/fckN6bE]https://discord.gg/fckN6bE[/url]

And if you want to help translating the game, go to: [url=https://translate.kingofretail.com/]https://translate.kingofretail.com/[/url]

Until next time, have a great sale.

Daniel

notes.title: Update 0.10.1 is out "Got something to drink?"
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers!

A month has gone by since the last release, but now a new update is finally available.[/b]


[h2]--- Beverages --- [/h2]
Since the entry of the groceries, i promised to add various drinks to the game. So this month has been about designing bottles, bottles and more bottles. This has resulted in over 170 new articles that will enter the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/76df56a461ccba5ff114c4d563842cf6e8c2e34f.png[/img]

They are spread out in 4 types. Wine, Beer, Soda and Liquor.
All of them are in the low luxury, however wine and liquor are quite high compared to the other grocery articles as well as being priced a bit higher.
This makes for some articles in the "Groceries" category that allows for a higher income, compared to the existing ones. 
Feedback indicated that it was relatively hard to make a "Groceries" department survive in the long run, so hopefully this will help making it easier to run a supermarket.


[h2]--- Displays ---[/h2]
The new articles also comes with a few new displays. 3 in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/1e5e28e1a22ff6a4bb249623c3c86f39be34fc27.png[/img]

Two of them are specific, made only for adding bottles to them, while the larger one is a general type display, which can also be used for other items.


[h2]--- Bugfixes & Balancing ---[/h2]
General programming has not been in focus for this update. However there has still been some issues which has been fixed.

- Staff not meeting for work.
There were issues where staff wouldn't show up for work. Apparently when assigning their schedule, if you clicked to the left of the opening hours this hour would be recorded as the meeting hour. But since this was before the store opened, they would never meet for work. They should now meet as desired.

- Problems of proceeding past tutorial.
When opening a new store, there is the basic tutorial of what to buy. If you hide the UI by menu or TAB, this screen was no longer focusable by the mouse, and made it impossible to end the day. 
This has also been fixed as well as making the "End Day" button available, so it will also be possible to skip this entirely.

- Register speed.
The speed at the registers have been adjusted again. Some articles were processed way to fast (some as quick as 0.1 seconds), making it possible to clear giant queues in no time. 
So this has been adjusted back a bit, and in general making it take a bit longer to process a customer.


[h2]--- Translations ---[/h2]
Translations are also making slow and steady progress.
To help with translating, go to: https://translate.kingofretail.com/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/21b64ae6f66018dcbb08560075a44705eb0365f3.png[/img]


[h2]--- Up next ---[/h2]
Now it is time for... more articles. 
Electronics was added a long time ago, however it has been left alone and with far too few articles. 
The reason for this was the sizes of general electronic products made it difficult to come up with articles and categories that would fit together. But with the introduction of shelf and autofitting displays this is no longer a problem.
So now it is time to fill up this category with lots of new items. What items that will be specifically i do not know yet. But i promise it will be a welcome and interesting addition.

I will also aim to add these articles in smaller intervals so when a pack is ready, it will be uploaded as soon as possible.


[b]This was it for now. Feedback is as always welcome.
Also, join our discord at: https://discord.gg/fckN6bE
Until next time. Happy sales.[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix uploaded
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers

A few bugs unfortunately slipped through the last update.[/b]

- When loading a game HQ managers start with 0 optimism.
They will now load as usual. Unfortunately already affected managers continue with their last saved value.

- Customers whislte and leave, when a register is closed which they are not in queue for. 
They will now behave as usual, and go to another register if the one they were heading to is closed.

- Staff will not require large wages when returning to a store after a lot of days.
Already affected staff will keep their wages, however will most likely not ask for a raise for a long time.

- Pressing ESC when editing a schedule caused the HUD to lock schedule. 
It should now work as requested.

- An issue switcing your managers name for a customers should no longer be possible.

[b]I am sorry for the inconveniences these bugs might have caused to your game experience. Thank you for the reports, and if other issues arrive, let me know and i will try and fix it as quiskly as possible.[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.10.0 is released "The Weekday Manager"
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers

The next version is finally out and ready for you to play. First of all i will apoligize for the elongated development time of this update, but i moved to a new location last month and had to work a lot to make it a liveable home.

However on the good side, i will from next week be getting some extra help making the game from a friend who wants to learn how to make graphics. His job will be to add content in various areas, and in general help with the time consuming tasks, such that i can better focus on the programming itself.
So hopefully it will be a good addition, allowing to add new and interesting things to the game.

The Admin team has also been expanded on the discord with two new members who have been so kind to help out answering your questions, and keep a great atmosphere, and they are doing a great job at it.

But now to the update.[/b]


[h2]--- The week ---[/h2]
The main focus of this update has been to introduce the week, meaning that we now have days and months instead of just a simple day counter. And this brings a lot of new interesting things to the game.

[h3]--- Staff scheduling ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/637a8d873a9c14f7c2c77d106efa50e2c4d9ba41.png[/img]
You can now set the schedule of each staff for the individual days of the week including assigning days off and different roles on each day. So it possible to tailor a complete schedule that will make the store run smoothly from day to day.

[h3]-- Customer flows[/h3]
The week also allows for different customer flows for each day. So farmers might prefer to shop on a monday, where the techies goes shopping on thursdays instead. And in the weekends everyone has a completely different shopping pattern compared to the workdays. So it's up to you to learn the different patterns and set up the store accordingly.

[h3]-- Opening hours[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/4d316e8d11fe6cd574ef24761441b0e6857c2ed5.png[/img]
Because of the different customer flows you might also want to keep different opening hours for your store so this is also possible now.

[h2]--- New Hud ---[/h2]
The main HUD in the store has also received an overhaul, to make it a bit more modern looking compared to the old one. This new hud also allows for some new features which you have requested.

[h3]--- First Person View ---[/h3]
It is now possible to play the game from a first person view. Feedback on how this mode han be improved is very welcome.

[h3]--- Hiding the HUD ---[/h3]
It is also now possible to hide the hud, for those of you who want to take better screenshots of your stores.

[h3]--- General Overhaul ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/80395222a10b5ab135b5c0d8cb1c5667b74da05c.png[/img]
The remaining screens has now been converted to the new style, and a few of them has received an overhaul.

[h2]--- Stats ---[/h2]
The stats system has also changed. The previous one caused lagging in longer games because of some bad code structure. So while doing this overhaul, some new features have been added.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/d4246e6ed448871d7e553a2012587b54f431d2b3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/3df6d515deb2af53d487a937d6ccf148f5095d61.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/93d1ee84a070eacabc582766fe84fe78e389da66.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/958a2b65871b1cc54ea068d24863e6e5b32863ec.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a8bec77369c723c00886c30ebdcf2d4cf500967a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f26782a78fef3a57d337b655e50d6416f31358bd.png[/img][/url]

The customers will now give you feedback of their experience while shopping at your store through customer reports. It is also now possible to see what each segment perfers in a more understandable way. Finally you can also see the shopping stats for the segments on each day. So hopefully these tools will make it easier to make decisions on what to do. 
All of this can be found on your computer in your office.

[h2]--- Minor Updates ---[/h2]
Besides this, other features have also been added.

[h3]--- Minimum Storage Sytem on articles ---[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/187961aa616b40dd7577b98cccbf62fb72329196.png[/img]
You can now adjust the desired amount of articles used by the Minimum Storage Info directly on the articles using the Edit Article menu

[h3]--- Customers Queuing ---[/h3]
There have been lots of complaints regarding the queuing of the customers. They should now be more intelligent, and spread out to the various registers. 

[h3]--- ABC locations ---[/h3]
Have you got some articles you want to get rid of, or want more sales of that high earning item? Then make the customers see this as the first thing when they enter your store.
You can now add focus on various articles in your store. The closer a display is to the store front, the more interesting it will be for the customer to look at. 

[h3]--- Register speed by article ---[/h3]
There were some balancing issues regarding selling groceries. As these are low priced items, the customers will now take more of each. However this then added longer queues at the registers. To combat this, the amount of time it takes to process an article now also depends on the luxury of that item. So selling a food item at the register, will now be faster than selling a computer.
In future more will be added to balance out various categories.

[h3]--- Corp Applications ---[/h3]
The applications you receive will now be based of your HQ level. So when obtaining a bigger HQ, you will most likely get better applicants.

[h2]--- Bugs ---[/h2]
As always lots of bugs have been corrected, and a lot new has most likely entered. Thanks to all of you who have beta tested the game, and provided feedback.

[h3]--- Menu centering ---[/h3]
There were some issues with ingame menus having weird offsets on other resolutions than the standard 1920 x 1080. This should have been corrected, and menus should now appear on top of their respective inventory.

[h3]--- LMB missing once in a while ---[/h3]
There have been a longstanding issue with LMB suddently not registering when placing items. I can't get this to happen myself, so can't track it down. However i have tried to fix some of the areas that might cause this, but if it continues to happen i am very interested in hearing about it.

[h2]--- What's next? ---[/h2]
So with this update out, what are the upcoming plans?

[h3]-- The stand by period ---[/h3]
As always after a large update, there is a "Stand By" period, meaning i don't do larger changes for a week or so, but instead stand ready to fix bugs that might arrive, such that a fix can be made and uploaded quickly. So a few minor patches might arrive during the upcoming week.

[h3]--- More articles (And this time it's true) ---[/h3]
It was the meaning that more articles should have been added this patch. However a lot of feedback indicated that it was a huge task managing the staff each day on larger stores. Therefore the only solution to this was to add a complete week such that you could add fixed days off for your staff, so that it would be more automated.
But with this out of the way, it is time to add articles as promised. There will first be added various drinks, to round off the groceries category, and after that all attention will go to expand electronics.
This will probably happen over two several patches, but work on this will start tomorrow.

This was the info regarding this update. Please do let me know of bugs, balancing issues, thoughts or great ideas.
Also feel free to join our discord at:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE

notes.title: 0.9.0 is released for Mac. Small UI update for windows.
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers
A minor update is released :)[/b]

[h2]Mac realeased[/h2]

We finally got the Mac version up and running, meaning you also have access to the latest major update.

We still haven't fully solved the issue with exporting to Mac, meaning that updates may be a few days delayed. We will still work on this issue, and hopefully be able to bring updates simultaneously.

-----------------------
[h2]Minor UI update[/h2]

We have also received feedback that the new UI is a bit too overwhelming, and that some of the functionalities aren't too obvious, and that you miss some of the old functionalities.
So we have made some changes that should improve this in the most essential areas. 

- You can select colors on the inventory before buying.
- On displays you have the option to edit all locations at the same time (like before), or to micromanage them individually.
- You are again shown how many items remains to be unpacked from the storage.

Feel free to tell us what and how you think the UI can be improved further, as the next period will be dedicated to adjust various things according to the feedback you give us regarding the latest update.

-----------------------
[h2]Customer entry update[/h2]

Customers did also not enter the store at random, making the  start of a store even harder. This has also been corrected.

Due to what is mentioned above, this update will be published within the next days for Mac also.

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 is out - The Supermarket Owner
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Retailers

The latest update is finally out, bringing a lot of new features into the game.

First of all a HUGE thank you, to all of you who have participated in the beta testing of this version. A lot of bugs have been found, as well as several features have been implemented and changed thanks to you. It has been extremely helpful, and have saved lots of time and frustrations, and hopefully it will bring a better experience to all of those going to play it.[/b]

[h2]-- Groceries --[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/5293b52f1c26405bd3b34abf578afe71b9a50e3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/a3200610494cfd22174f88ee539ec438e421e900.png[/img]
The biggest feature is the new category "Groceries" which has been what this update is revolving around. It includes a whole new set of articles to sell in your stores. These are various canned and packaged foods, food for refrigeration, fruits and vegetables. Over the next updates even more articles will be added.

[h2]-- Displays --[/h2]
[h3]- Complete rework -[/h3]
For making this category work, the display system needed a complete overhaul. The old system only allowed for items of the same size. This system has been the main problem when we wanted to add new categories and articles.
The new system allows for categories to "share" displays while still being able to maintain some unique ones for that category only. They also allow articles of various sizes, and will automatically fit that. So a table might have 4 computers, but 8 mice. So this will make it much easier to add new articles to the game in the future. The new system also allow you to place a specific article at a specific location, which the staff will now respect. So you can now create a shoe wall featuring only unique shoes,if that is what you desire.

[h3]- Shelf types -[/h3]
A new type of display has also come to the game, the shelf display. This allow you to add shelves, and adjust these to the type of article you expect to show on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/f2443003cf2abb95059f91296e84d3fd992cfadb.png[/img]

[h3]- Signs -[/h3]
All displays also now has the possibility to be equipped with a billboard you can customize with various texts, colors and patterns.

[h3]- Colors -[/h3]
We have also disposed of the old "Material Sphere" system. With this system, it was hard to make all interactables to be compatible with these generic materials, and also didn't allow for each display to receive a unique look. Now, the displays has received a unique look which you can colorize. The visuals for the displays will be further improved over the next updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/e9538645bda82e990d7c66616a723ec5f7c9ddad.png[/img]

[h3]- Color picker -[/h3]
As this brings a lot of emphasis on colors, the color picker has also been upgraded and you can now save colors across stores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/21c00aecce0289f786bf2a7fa4220cd51b37cc49.png[/img]

[h2]-- UI --[/h2]
For all of this to happen, the UI for all of these things needed an upgrade. So we have tried with a new look, and new functionalities that supports the future of many categories and articles better than the old one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/fc3c7e0f093b209222fd10299cb51d30d2436fc8.png[/img]

[h2]-- Registers --[/h2]
[h3]- New types -[/h3]
We have also upgraded the looks and functionality off all the registers, as well as adding new ones to the game. The queues have also been changed, so in general they will occupy less space, than their old counterparts. They are all also now equpped with a status light, showing if they are open, closed for new customers or completely closed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/adf4be2ba899f0084a66238b3aa30bde4f65c0d3.png[/img]

[h3]- New functionality -[/h3]
The registers have also been changed to allow for various amounts of customers. So the small and cheap ones only allow for few customers, while the large and more expensive ones allows for more and also occupy more space.

[h2]-- Staff UI --[/h2]
We have added a menu to the hud showing all of your staff who are currently at work. From here you can assign them new tasks, or send them on break.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/695444f2c90a3b98caea70ebfcfe20e8fc2e47a3.png[/img]

[h2]-- Day Progress --[/h2]
[h3]- Closed for unlimited time -[/h3]
If you decide to close the store for an entire day, you will now have all the time in the world to redecorate your store. 

[h3]- Extra delivery -[/h3]
In the HUD, a new button has also been added under "Articles". With this you can request an extra article delivery for a fee. So you can during the day order extra articles if you run out of space or if you forgot to order.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/cb15d26dd1bd8b3931bec1668726db0fd0f1d8dd.png[/img]

[h2]-- Save Game Issues --[/h2]
Unfortunately, the new display system made the old ones obsolete to a point where they were incompatible with each other. So as a consequence, all displays have been removed from the stores. However we have compensated for this, by refunding the displays. The articles placed on them, have been added to be delivered the next day. You have received a compensation for each article that is going to be redelivered. Finally you have also received money for the rent of a missing day. We therefore recommend to close the store for a day to rebuild it, and you can request articles again and again during this day due to the new features.

We are terribly sorry for the inconveniences of this, but hopefully these compensations will ake it up to you.

[h2]-- Languages --[/h2]
[h3]- Player Translations -[/h3]
Our community translator also came into action during this patch. We weren't sure how it would turn out, but much to our suprise it has been widely used. We are very humbled that so many has taken their time to translate sentence after sentence. Thank you A LOT to all of you who have been assisting with this. This should have improved the existing languages, but we also tried adding new languages to the game. And even more to our suprise, some of you have taken their time to translate the game to an entire new language.

So a very special thank you to the following users:

Lucas (Translated the entire game into French)
WensElf (Translated the entire game into Dutch)
sztilo07 (Has translated over half the game into Hungarian)
iTzAlexandre (Has translated a quarter of the game into Portuguese)

[h3] - Back to english -[/h3]
Due to how these translations is made, some words might be incorrect, understood in the wrong context, extending a bounding box or missing, as the translators havent been able to test out their translations while translating, but could only see them in game when the beta was updated. Since the game automatically detects your language, you might start out your game in your local language. If you are, and you find any of the above annoying, you always have the possibility to swich back to English language.

[h3]- Want to help translating -[/h3]
If you want to help with the translations, go to:
https://translate.kingofretail.com/

[h2]-- Mac Issue --[/h2]
Finally, Mac users will have to wait a bit extra for this update.
We are making the game for windows, which allows for exporting to various platforms. However MacOS is not included in this. For building to Mac, Apple requires it to be done on a  n Apple device. We are currently experiencing some issues getting Unreal Engine (which is the program we create the game in) to run on Mac. We are trying to solve this, but we don't want to hold back the update for windows. So we are very very sorry that we can't offer you the update right away, but as soon as we are able to, we will provide it for you also.


------------------------------------------------------


[b]This rounds of the news of this update.
We are very interested in receiving feedback, ideas and hearing about bug or issues you may encounter. You can do that here at Steam or at our discord:
https://discord.gg/fckN6bE[/b]

We hope you will enjoy the changes, and happy retailing out there :)

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 is out.
notes.notes:
Dear Retailers

The latest update is ready for you.

[h1][u][b] Bug fixes and adjustments [/b][/u][/h1]

Corporation Mode has been received well, which we are incredibly happy about. But as it gets some playtime, more bugs emerge that we have not been aware of. So this update has focused on eradicating a lot of them.

The biggest problem has been withdeliveries where an error changed some floor assignments from storage to store. It should be fixed, but in saved games it may still be an issue. If there is a problem, try moving around the storage units such that they again are in a allowed location.

Loans also work properly again. In addition, loans, rents and wages are paid at the end of the day instead of various times dring the day.

Please tell us if anything else should show up. We will continue to focus on removing errors and sending out small updates.


[h1][u][b]Own Logos[/b][/u][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/38d12f934c1eab44ba3d19e52e0811cc777fa660.jpg[/img]

It is now possible to add your own logos. Follow our guide here on Steam on how to create your own.
Logos from old games will probably have changed. However, it is now also possible to change logos in the game.
In Entrepreneur games, they can be changed inside the office, and in Corporation games you can change them through your concepts.


[h1][u][b]New Sales Interaction[/b][/u][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/aa61c782a69b631d72469de781946b7a5afe12a0.png[/img]

We have updated the sales system to be clearer and more intuitive, which hopefully allows for better sales and more money.


[h1][u][b] New Storage System [/b][/u][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023693/ac9514f677e490fe38d023a5f445be2c9afd5560.png[/img]

Your office computer has a new system. Here you can choose how many items you want in stock. On the order screen, the system can then order up to this number. Nice and easy.




[b] Tell us what you think needs to be updated and changed. Many of these things comes out of players' wishes, so don't hold back.

Happy sales out there! [/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.7.1 is up
notes.notes:
We received notifications of several issues with the game, to which we have released a hotfix. Thank you a lot :-) 

Mainly:
- You can transfer funds when your corporation is in negative
- The unlimited concepts / store HQ actually allows for unlimited.
- You can buy a store you have rented.
- Buying a store only cost money if you actually get it.

and some other issues.

We are aware that loans are currently not deducted properly, but coudn't get it in for this update.

We will focus the next period on clearing bugs, and update as needed. So please let us know if you find more.

notes.title: Version 0.6.0 is ready for you
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/a1eace62467d2763014e0955d6c1b8b2a6680455.png[/img]

Dear Retailers

[b]A month has gone by since our last release, and we have now finished work on this one. So what does it contain?
[/b]

[b][h1]New Articles[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/43acef0d51d1d13df68cca299866cd39fc3a3219.png[/img]

- Some of the shirts have been updated to better looking models. 
- Several shoes has been added, and some replaced (There will be added more shoes over time, also replacing older models).
- A new category "Pants" has been added, containing a lot of these to sell.


[b][h1]Close for a day[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/9295300188721847b89f71c130291d3410fa9916.png[/img]

It is now possible to keep closed for an entire day, allowing you to do whatever you feel like for an entire day. In the next patch there will also be an opportunity to request special deliveries, allowing you to order articles on this day also to give what you might need.


[b][h1]Better ordering[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/ce4f56cc548d0235c0db828d8ebcd31fbbf57de9.png[/img]

Ordering has received some upgrades. You can browse your previous orders, and also reorder what has been sold the same day. This should make it easier to manage the stock.


[b][h1]New storage items[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/77e3afe69a71e914e84f297215cf3af123dbf0a3.png[/img]

The storage has received several units to choose from. Both to store your articles, and to receive deliveries on. This unfortunately means that the old units has been removed, impacting save games. However these will be refunded, and you will not lose any articles that was saved on thee units.


[b][h1]Balancing[/h1][/b]
It was getting too easy earning lots of money from day 1, so we have adjusted the game in several areas.

[b]Reputation gains:[/b]
It didn't take many days to receive full reputation in all areas. So the gains have been downscaled a bit for categories, and quite a lot for customer segments. So now you have to fight more in the beginnings to get customers into the store, using catalogues, forum posts and fetching them from the streets.

[b]Reputation losses:[/b]
The penalty for having customers leaving the store was basically so small that it didn't have any effect. This penalty has been increased such that these customers has an influence. So try and keep them all happy :) 

[b]Article saturations:[/b]
It was possible to keep selling the same few articles over and over again each day. This is still possible, but now the customers will be less willing to buy these articles. So for maximum sale, it is needed to keep a large variety of articles, or to change out the assortment once in a while.


[b][h1]Other minor features[/h1][/b]
[b]- Staff on registers going on break.[/b]
It was quite annoying when staff went to break, if they manned the only register. Now, if they are the only one on register, they will allow the register open and just go on break. If there are others with an open register, they will finish their queue, and then head for break.

[b]- Staff are better at restocking[/b]
Staff didn't always fill out a display if a location wasn't completely empty. This has also been adjusted, and they should now be better at restocking.

[b]- Staff can help with cleanup of boxes[/b]
If there are boxes with articles on the ground, the staff can now also help unpack those, if they have unlocked the talent for it off course.

[b]- Improvement of space requirements[/b]
All inventory have had their space requirements updated, so there should not be any more annoying overlappings "cheating" you of valuable space.

[b]- Even better AI movement[/b]
The AI movement have been adjusted further, and should allow for even better moving among each other.


[b][h1]Bugs and bugs[/h1][/b]
As always many bugs has been removed, and new ones has most certainly entered. So we still need all of your help and feedback in spotting more of these when you encounter them :-) 


[b]And we are still very interested in listening to anything you might have to say of what is good, what can be better, and all your great ideas. We are especially interested in listening to what you feel the game need work on, if it's more articles, new features, balancing or something else.

We hope you enjoy our work
\\ The Devs[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 is out
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Dear retailers: Update 0.5.0 is out.[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/33f20d7a4f56cc7620956c191afdf098a835c2eb.png[/img]
[h1]New category: Computers[/h1]
We listen to what you want - More items to sell.
The addition of computers seemed like a straightforward thing to do. So this is a new category, with corresponding new new displays.
These articles are more expensive, both when buying and selling and are of a higher luxury. 
This means that the customers are pickier, and needs an overall better sales efforts before they purchase.

[h1]Events, calendar and mails[/h1]
The city has to be more dynamic. So various events will occur once in a while. For instance a discount from a certain supplier or an increase in a population segment.
You can see various events on your new Calendar. This is accessible through the HUD menu in store, or from the newly placed calendar near the door in your office.
When an event occurs, you are notified via mail on your computer. Your staff now also mails you about various events like sickness or resignations.
This system is just finished, so you can expect lots of events to be added in the future.

[h1]Bankruptcy[/h1]
Yes. Due to the arrival of the event system, it is now possible to go bankrupt. So no more owing the bank millions of (insert currency here), 
but instead you have a certain amount of days to fix the situation before the store gets closed.

[h1]Improved AI movement[/h1]
The AI had a tendency to clump and walk in the way of each other, causing some undesirable behavior and following frustration.
This has been adjusted allowing for a much better flow even when crowded. In crowded situations they still "wiggle" about, but manage to pass each other and reach their destination. 
We hope this will improve the experience in bigger stores. 

[h1]News[/h1]
We wanted to be able to communicate with the players more directly, so a news feed has been implemented at the main menu screen. Here we will post about what is coming, tips to things we see players struggle with and other notifications.

[h1]More bugs[/h1]
We are receiving a lot of bug reports, and thank you very much for those.
We have removed a fair share of them (but others are bound to have arrived). Please continue to post any difficulties or bad experiences you might have, and we will try to solve them.



[u][h1][b]Up next[/b][/h1][/u]
It is summer and 50 % of the team is going for a well earned vacation, and the other half of the team (me) will stay home and continue working.

[h1]Currency selector[/h1]
We see people get confused about the prices, which makes perfectly sense. At the moment the game uses an unspecified currency, with values based on the unknown Danish Krone which makes no sense to 99.9 of the earths population.
So we will make a currency designer where you can select various currencies, or create your own. This should make the game more familiar to all of you.

[h1]User Preferences[/h1]
There has also been requests for various minor implementations. So we will create an overdue preferences menu for you to customize your experience. This will off course grow over time, so feel free to let us know what you think this screen should contain.

[h1]Next Category[/h1]
Since we have the clothes / shoes pair. It should also be possible to sell minor computer accessories. So we will begin making monitors, keyboards, mice and what else we might think off.

[h1]Languages[/h1]
There has been an increasing demand to translate the game into different languages, and we will therefore begin working on this. However as this is totally new to us we don't know how long this will take to do.

[h1]City mode[/h1]
We have a dream of making a 3D city overview that contains the game instead of menus. This should contain entrepreneur and career mode combined, along with opening chains of stores that work together. 
This city view should also contain a corporate HQ, supplier expos, tutorial school and what else we might put in there. This should make for a more complete gaming experience, making it feel like building an empire, and creating a more diverse and challenging gameplay. 
So this will be our next major project that we will begin working on.

[u][h1][b]We hope you enjoy the changes and, as always, if you have ideas, found bugs, or any other feedback don't hesitate to let us know.[/b][/h1][/u]

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 is out
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34023693/fb592fb17d2b2b243c678a1564e368e53d7df6ab.png[/img]

[b]Finally, it's out ːsteamhappyː

First of all, a GREAT thanks to all of you who are playing our game. We have been very overwhelmed of the interest it has received. The amount of playtime we see is more than what we could have hoped for. 
We also received the attention of several youtubers playing our game with, these 3 creating rougly 2 million views combined.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nW2btbC-oro&t=11s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zSelrrOMs1g&t=7s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t3iBeWsoGjU&t=9s

But after a long developing period to this patch has finally come to an end.
We have managed to put a lot into it, including accomodating a few community requests. We are sorry we passed the promised deadline for all of you waiting for the update. We hope you can forgive us :-) [/b]

[h1][u][b]So what did it end up with?[/b][/u][/h1]
[h1]City changes[/h1]
As mentioned earlier, the way the city functions has changed. Customers are divided into segments, each having distinct traits. So you now also need to gain reputation with these segments, along with reputation for the categories that you sell.

[h1]Staff updates[/h1]
As mentioned a big part was building talent trees for your staff. This means staff develop in the way you desire for them. They might be experienced in a role upon hiring, bringing additional bonuses to that task. They might be inexperienced in others meaning negative actions might occur while learning that part. Some they can not even perform before having taken the appropriate course to learn. 
Although not changed dramatically, a few changes has been made to the interviewing part to accomodate these changes, and in preparation for future features.

[h1]Customer interactions[/h1]
There was a lot of feedback coming from you, indication the desire for a change to the way of interacting with customers.
So we prioritized this. 
Instead of being a hit or miss system, you can now interact with the customers in a more direct way. Try to boost a need, or create a desire for a specific article. Quickly jump from customer to customer in a busy hour and help them all a bit, or spend your time with one, trying to build up the big sale. You decide completely.
In the dull hours, you can stand outside, and pull in some of the pedestrians walking by the store.

[h1]Magazine designer[/h1]
At the office it is now possible to create advertisment spreads to feature in the city's magazines. Select the magazine, the size, the featured ads and publish it. It will provide a boost to your reputation, along with a boost to certain customer segments walking by your store.

[h1]Forum posts[/h1]
You can also build reputation by creating posts at the community forums. Choose the parameters of the post, and watch it gain momentum with views and comments.
[b]This feature is still in the early stages, as we would like to gain inputs from you on how to proceed with this feature. So it will be improved upon in the future.[/b] 

[h1]Others[/h1]
A lot of bugs has been fixed (and others most likely arrived). 
The time of performing various actions has been adjusted, along with customer waiting times. 
Customers are now a bit more expressive during their shopping experience. While we have had no focus on adding graphics content, the main menu world have been changed along with other minor graphical changes.

[h1]Saves[/h1]
Due to the previous setup [u][b]your saves will be deleted from the game[/b][/u]. We are sorry for this inconvenience of losing all of your magnificent store out there, however we have been cought a bit off guard on managins several versions (As this is our first game, we are still learning a lot all the time).
We will try and restructure things in the future to accomodate different version compatibility, but will not yet promise that it won't happen again in the future, due to this restructuring. We know it sucks, but we might as well be up front about it.

[h1][u][b]What's next[/b][/u][/h1]
[h1]More content[/h1]
Since the majority of the feedback requested more items, we will spend a fair amount of time from now on adding more content into the game. This means, among other things, that we will focus on adding more articles, more inventory, more categories, more career mode possibilities, and more of other  forms content we can create.

[h1]Shorter development periods[/h1]
Due to the duration of this patch, the next couple of patches will be aimed to have a considerably shorter development time. So along with the adding content, we will try not to make so many big implementations at the same time.

[h1]Feedback is VERY welcome[/h1]
Due to the changes of this patch, there are bound to be bugs we have missed. 
We are also, as always, interested in your opinions, ideas, experiences and cool stories you might have regarding the game. We are interested to know if there are any balancing issues, so we can get it adjusted.
So please, PLEASE, feel free to let us know about it. We encourage you to use the discussion board here on Steam as we regularly check in to see what you have written, and are very interested to talk about what direction the game should take.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
As of now we have not decided 100 % on what the next patch should contain, other than the addition of content. So regarding the topic above, you can have a great influence on what will come next. 
We off course have a million ideas on things we want to do, so our task is to organize the next part of the development. And with that, we will try to make a road map, so all of you can see what our thought on the game is, and what you might expect in the future.


That escalated to a lot of reading ːsteamhappyː
We hope you enjoy the new additions, and again we are very interested in antyhing you might have to say about them.

Kind regards

The King of Retail dev team.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Fellow retailers,

It's been a little more than a week since King of Retail launched on Early Access and what a week it was! We are overwhelmed by your interest, engagement and support for our game and we wish to thank you all. Your posts on the discussion boards and feedback from the in-game menu has helped us greatly in catching bugs and given us plenty of ideas for future content. It has definitely sparked our motivation to improve the game even further!

We would also like to thank the YouTuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzEy7pi3B7TIS9cn_sdKK9A]GrayStillPlays[/url] for making a very entertaining video about King of Retail and if you haven't seen his video/channel yet we can't recommend it enough!

Now onto the patch contents! We decided to collect your very helpful bug reports/feedback and weed out all the bugs we could this week. So here's a change list:

[h1]v0.3.1 changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] All audio settings will now be saved/loaded between game sessions
[*] Added separate channels for Ambience and Door Bell sounds in the Audio Settings
[*] Fixed the sound played when you win a level in career mode to be part of the Sound Effects group so it no longer causes increased heart rate and your ears to bleed
[*] The mailman will no longer get stuck and review his life choices while delivering articles
[*] Fixed an issue where the career offers would get duplicated in the main menu
[*] The career level where you have to break even in 5 days will now show a prompt when you fail the contract, despite the realism being stuck in a failing business
[*] AI's will no longer get stuck (behind the scenes) after spawning and affecting performance
[*] When loading a game the jukebox will now start playing again
[*] Reworked the animation system for characters and added new animations #CantHaveEnoughAnimations
[*] Added some new hair styles and face types
[*] Fixed an issue with the registers and staff not being able to access them due to lacking space between the wall and the register
[*] Staff can no longer use "the force" to interact with objects that are being moved by the manager
[*] The game will no longer implode on itself when adding/removing articles from a display simultaneously
[*] Inventory packed in boxes will no longer deduct funds when moving/placing the box
[*] Fixed a glitch in the matrix where the marketing PC would sometimes spawn inside a wall
[*] Added the marketing PC to the "Getting Started" checklist when starting a new store
[*] Unemployment rate suddenly spiked: Job applications will now always appear in your office
[*] You can no longer negotiate with multiple people at the same time
[*] While in your office, pressing ESC will now zoom out of any interaction
[*] Fixed a visual bug where only half the screen would be blurry when pausing a game (opening Settings menu)
[*] Pallets now require a larger space around them to be placed to avoid navigation for AI's to be blocked (might affect existing save games, but will fix itself when placed again)
[*] Fixed some of our broken English throughout the game ;) 
[/list]

Thank you all for helping us track down most of these bugs! As for the future we will begin focusing on adding three new mechanics to the game namely a talent tree for you staff, replacing the customer interaction system with a new and improved design and adding new ways to do marketing for you stores. When we are a bit further in our design of these we might show and tell a bit ;) 
Don't forget to visit our [url=https://www.facebook.com/kingofretail/]Facebook Page[/url] for announcements, competitions and more!

We wish you all a great weekend and good luck in your sales!
-The dev team

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Dear retailers,
we are very excited and happy to announce that King of Retail is now officially out on Early Access!

First and foremost we would like to extend thanks to all of our beta-testers, your testing and feedback has helped tremendously in catching those pesky bugs and we hope you will lend us your continued support going forward.

With that said we are very interested in your thoughts and ideas about the game. Are you ready to start as a brand new manager and challenge yourself by completing various contracts in the career mode? Or perhaps you are more into being your own boss and set your own goals in the entrepreneur mode? Feel free to share your thoughts on the King of Retail Community Hub or from the in-game feature, we'll be sure to check in and listen!

As for the future we are already in the process of designing and developing the next features for the game and we would like to give you a heads up on what that is:

[h1]Talent tree for you manager[/h1]
Becoming the next King of Retail is not a simple task but instead a long and challening process. There are a lot of different aspects in retail: handling sales, ordering stock and managing staff to name a few. And no matter how good you are you can not become the ultimate expert in each aspect. We would like to introduce a talent tree for the manager where you, as a player, will have the ability to choose which aspects you'd like to pursue and become an expert in.

[h1]No marketing, no profit![/h1]
Building and setting up a store is no small task but all your efforts might go to waste if no one even knows you exist. That is why marketing is vital for success! We'd like to expand on the current marketing aspect in the game with more ways to build up your reputation and get those customers inside the store. But marketing can come in many forms, such as online campaigns, catalogues, ads or even shouting at pedestrians on the street! We are currently working out which methods would fit the game best so more on this later.

[h1]Customer interaction[/h1]
The current implementation of how you interact with the customers when they ask for help is admittely a mechanic from the game's early days and we feel this needs a rework! Interacting with customers is your chance as a manager to directly affect the sales. As with much in retail, this comes with a risk! Being too pushy might end in the customer being annoyed and leave your store without making a purchase. But with the right pitch and sweet talk you could convince the customer to buy more than intended, earning you a boost in sales! We would like to capture this risk-reward aspect into to a simple interaction where you would make a choice: Do I take the safe route to guarantee a sale or do I push extra hard to influence the customer in spending more money than intended?


There is still a long road ahead of us and we hope the three points above help steer the game in the right direction. Again we are very eager to hear what you think about King of Retail, be it good or bad we will take both into consideration!

We wish you luck on your way to becoming the next King of Retail!

-The King of Retail dev team
